results.title: Executive Sous Chef
results.description: Muse is a blend of artful experiences that range from our culinary presentation and service, to the colorful wine collection and craft-made cocktails, all married with a cultural, art–filled environment. Together, it sets the tone for a unique dining experience for Stevens Point and central Wisconsin. Muse is currently seeking a talented and experienced individual to join the team as an Executive Sous Chef. If you have a passion for cooking, leading the kitchen, and have excellent communication skills, this position may be a fit for you! What You'll Do As an Executive Sous Chef, you will: Provide leadership and guidance to the culinary teams and fosters a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Works closely with the Executive Chef to help develop innovative menus and concepts that reflect culinary trends and guest preferences. Collaborate with the Executive Chef and Restaurant Managers to develop seasonal menus, daily specials, and catering offerings that showcase farm-to-table ingredients, culinary expertise, and creativity. Develops menu concepts from start to finish, creates menu, budgets menu cost, and presents final tasting to leadership team. Monitors menu performance, gathers feedback, and make adjustments as necessary to enhance guest satisfaction and profitability. Mentor and train kitchen staff in culinary techniques, food preparation methods, and sanitation practices. Diseminates recipe instructions and creates daily workflows needed for new menu rollout. Fosters a culture of learning and development, providing opportunities for growth and advancement within the culinary team. Oversee the larger scope of day-to-day kitchen operations, including food preparation, production, and presentation, ensuring adherence to quality standards, food safety regulations, and cost control measures. Implements efficient workflows and procedures to optimize kitchen efficiency and productivity. Manage food inventory levels, procurement, and vendor relationships to ensure adequate supply levels while minimizing waste and controlling costs/delivery time. Conduct regular inventory audits and implements strategies to optimize inventory turnover, product rotation, and minimize shrinkage. Maintain high standards of food quality, consistency, and presentation, conducting regular tastings and inspections to uphold Sentry's reputation for service and quality. Address any issues or concerns promptly, implementing corrective actions as needed. Ensure compliance with all state, federal, and industrial health, safety, and sanitation regulations, conducting regular inspections and team training to uphold the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene in the kitchen. Administer human resource-related activities including timely performance and salary reviews. Ensure all subordinates adhere to human resources policies and practices. Completes scheduling & payroll processes for assigned team members. Additionally, You Will Work closely with Restaurant Manager and front-of-house staff to deliver exceptional dining experiences that exceed guest expectations. Collaborate on special events, promotions, and themed dinners to enhance guest engagement and satisfaction. Responsible for meticulously organizing the food items required for the daily menu within the framework of each restaurant's unique concept, ensuring seamless execution and adherence to culinary standards. Oversee and providing leadership to the back-of-house staff when the Executive Chef is unavailable, ensuring smooth operations and maintaining high standards of performance in their absence. Actively support and cultivate a culture of "concierge-like" service by consistently delivering a personalized and exceptional level of service ensuring customer satisfaction. Partner with Executive Chef to hold daily line-up meetings to go over shift expectations. Perform other job-related duties as assigned from time to time. What It Takes Technical degree from Culinary Institute or equivalent work experienceMinimum of 4 years of relevant work experienceTIPS certification requiredServSafe certification requiredStrong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Knowledge of culinary techniques, food trends, industry best practices, and all aspects of food preparation. Wood burning oven experience desirable. Farm-to-table experience desirable. Proficient with Microsoft Excel. Experience in banquet preparation and planning. Ability to work flexible scheduling including early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays as needed. What You'll Receive At Sentry, your total rewards go beyond competitive compensation. Below are some benefits and perks that you’ll receive. Competitive Compensation to reward you for your hard workEligibility for a Quarterly Performance BonusGenerous Holiday Pay, Paid-Time Off and Floating Holidays for you to enjoy time “out of the office”Group Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance to encourage a healthy lifestyle401 (K) match after 1 year of service to help fund your futureAssociate discounted shift meals and golf ratesFree Wellness Center MembershipExtensive Work-Life Resources to lend a helping hand. Our bright future is built on a long track record of success. We got our start in 1904 and have been helping businesses succeed and protect their futures ever since. Because of the trust placed in us, we’re one of the largest and financially strongest mutual insurance companies in the United States. We’re rated A+ by A.M. Best, the industry's leading rating authority. Our headquarters is in Stevens Point, Wisconsin, with offices located throughout the United States. From sales to claims, and information technology to marketing, we enjoy a rewarding and challenging work environment with opportunities for ongoing professional development and growth. results.title: Sous Chef
results.description: We have an incredible opportunity for a dynamic, inspirational culinary leader to join our New York Kitchen as a Sous Chef! Who We Are: We have a passion for hospitality culinary delights on every banquet floor and in the sky. With the three business segments of Airline Catering, International Event Catering, and Restaurants, Lounges & Hotels, DO & CO offers gourmet entertainment all over the world. We operate in 32 locations, 12 countries and 3 continents, maintaining the highest standard of quality in both our products and services. We refine the classics, develop the unknown and grow constantly – sometimes beyond our own expectations. Responsibilities: Oversee all daily kitchen operations and culinary staff within designated areas. Implement daily food service protocols, emphasizing quality, technique, portion control, presentation, and cost efficiency. Assess ingredient freshness and actively participate in food tastings. Establish standardized production recipes to maintain consistent quality across all offerings. Ensure uninterrupted supply of ingredients and products, promptly notifying the Executive Chef of any shortages or discrepancies. Monitor production processes to meet quality standards and deadlines consistently. Uphold meal specifications and uphold the highest quality standards in all culinary outputs. Provide support to the Executive Chef in catering proposals, fostering creativity, quality enhancement, presentation refinement, managing costs, preparing reports, and coordinating schedules. Contribute to the enhancement of catering services. Enforce maintenance and safety protocols, ensuring strict adherence to state and federal regulations regarding food storage, handling, and preparation. Maintain cleanliness and sanitation standards for culinary utensils, equipment, and overall kitchen hygiene. Preserve culinary excellence by training, motivating, and supervising kitchen personnel, overseeing culinary activities as assigned. Adjust kitchen staff availability based on business demands. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in culinary arts preferred. Minimum of 3 years of culinary expertise in running a successful full-service kitchen, with extensive production volume, ensuring high-quality products, efficient operations, and customer satisfaction.Proficiency in Mandarin and Cantonese cuisine is strongly preferred. Experience overseeing a team of at least 3 members.Familiarity with the latest trends in the catering industry is a plus. What We Offer: Full-Time employees are eligible for 401K, Commuter Benefits, and Healthcare Benefits such as Medical, Dental, & Vision. Daily Complimentary Meals (Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner). Member Perks and Discounts through our partnership with BenefitHub. An organization dedicated to fostering innovation; in pursuit of cultivating creativity, embracing new ideas and leveraging our impeccable standard for hospitality. Genuine career development opportunities, both nationally and internationally. The chance to collaborate and represent a leading force in the luxury global gourmet entertainment industry.

Additionally, you will provide leadership and mentorship to our chefs and kitchen staff, fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
